data.narrative:
Limelight Steel is a pre-seed stage Climate & Energy company founded by Olivia Dippo and Andy Zhao that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader Climate & Energy sector comp universe of 8 private companies and 1 public peer (LNZA), though narrow peer multiples proved insufficient for reliable triangulation.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach, applying a 2.5x multiplier to the $6M total raised as a pre-seed proxy baseline, yielding an implied valuation of $15M. The Peer-Median method was not applied due to insufficient data density: while 8 same-sector peers exist in the Climate & Energy universe, none satisfied the filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables. A broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias given sector-specific capital intensity and risk profiles.

The quantitative analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, centered on $15M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression median to account for execution risk and the single-method foundation. Key uncertainties include the lack of narrow-peer validation, early-stage capital requirements in deep tech hardware, and the absence of disclosed revenue or technical milestones that would refine the analysis. A subsequent funding round with disclosed terms would provide more robust calibration.
